28B. Cross-dataset generalization: CSE-CIC-IDS2018¶

Why this dataset?¶

Use CSE-CIC-IDS2018, specifically its Processed Traffic Data for ML Algorithms CSV files. It is a follow-on CIC/CSE network-intrusion dataset with labeled benign and malicious network flows and 80 CICFlowMeter-derived features. Its attack scenarios include brute force, Heartbleed, botnet, DoS/DDoS, web attacks, and infiltration. The official UNB page provides the data and AWS download instructions; COMIDDS documents the processed flow CSV structure and known dataset limitations.

  • Official dataset and download instructions: https://www.unb.ca/cic/datasets/ids-2018.html
  • Dataset documentation / processed feature example: https://fkie-cad.github.io/COMIDDS/content/datasets/cse_cic_ids2018/

Label compatibility: this project is binary. We map Benign to 0 and every other non-empty label to 1. Therefore the external dataset has the same two target classes as the trained model, but its original attack-family names are not identical to the 2017 taxonomy. This is not a 15-class, label-for-label transfer experiment.

Feature compatibility: CIC-IDS2018 uses a related CICFlowMeter feature family, but headers differ (for example, Dst Port versus Destination Port, and Tot Fwd Pkts versus Total Fwd Packets). The code below harmonizes known aliases, checks the intersection, and trains a source-only model using the shared feature set. It does not fabricate missing columns or refit preprocessing on the external data. Feature-name agreement is necessary but not sufficient: CICFlowMeter versions, units, collection conditions, and labeling limitations can still cause domain shift.

Local directory¶

Download only the labeled processed CSV files, not the raw PCAP/log archive, into:

data/external/CSE-CIC-IDS2018/Processed Traffic Data for ML Algorithms/

The official page gives an AWS CLI command for the processed folder. Because the full dataset is large, the loader below performs a chunked label audit and draws a binary-stratified sample that preserves the external dataset's benign/attack prevalence. It then evaluates a model trained only on CIC-IDS2017. The external labels are used only for scoring, not for fitting, feature selection, threshold tuning, or model selection.

The comparison reports both (1) source CIC-IDS2017 test performance using the shared feature set and (2) external CSE-CIC-IDS2018 performance using the same trained model. This makes the observed cross-domain performance drop interpretable.

In [31]:

def normalize_schema_token(name):
    """Normalize a header for matching; does not change the underlying feature values."""
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "", str(name).replace("\ufeff", "").casefold())


# Canonical CIC-IDS2017 model feature -> common CIC-IDS2018 header aliases.
# Exact normalized header matches are attempted first; aliases cover known abbreviations.
CIC2018_FEATURE_ALIASES = {
    "Destination Port": ["Dst Port"],
    "Total Fwd Packets": ["Tot Fwd Pkts"],
    "Total Backward Packets": ["Tot Bwd Pkts"],

def read_external_csv_header(path):
    errors = []
    for enc in ["utf-8-sig", "cp1252", "latin1"]:
        try:
            cols = pd.read_csv(path, nrows=0, encoding=enc).columns.tolist()
            if not cols:
                raise ValueError("Empty CSV header")
            return cols, enc
        except Exception as exc:
            errors.append(f"{enc}: {exc}")
    raise RuntimeError(f"Cannot read header for {path.name}: {' | '.join(errors)}")


def map_external_features(raw_columns, required_features):
    normalized_lookup = {}
    for raw_col in raw_columns:
        normalized_lookup.setdefault(normalize_schema_token(raw_col), []).append(raw_col)

    mapping = {}
    ambiguous = {}
    missing = []
    for feature in required_features:
        candidate_tokens = [normalize_schema_token(feature)]
        candidate_tokens.extend(
            normalize_schema_token(alias)
            for alias in CIC2018_FEATURE_ALIASES.get(feature, [])
        )
        matches = []
        for token in candidate_tokens:
            matches.extend(normalized_lookup.get(token, []))
        matches = list(dict.fromkeys(matches))
        if len(matches) == 1:
            mapping[feature] = matches[0]
        elif len(matches) == 0:
            missing.append(feature)
        else:
            ambiguous[feature] = matches
    return mapping, missing, ambiguous


def scan_external_label_counts(paths, chunk_size=EXTERNAL_CHUNK_SIZE):
    """First pass: read only the external Label column to count binary classes."""

    counts = Counter()
    total_rows = 0
    missing_labels = 0

    for path in paths:
        info = external_file_info[path.name]
        encoding = info["encoding"]
        for chunk in pd.read_csv(
            path,
            usecols=lambda c: normalize_schema_token(c) == "label",
            chunksize=chunk_size,
            encoding=encoding,
            low_memory=False,
        ):
            if chunk.shape[1] != 1:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Expected one Label column in {path.name}; "
                    f"got {chunk.columns.tolist()}"
                )
            labels = chunk.iloc[:, 0].astype("string").str.strip()
            valid = labels.notna() & labels.ne("")
            missing_labels += int((~valid).sum())
            labels = labels.loc[valid]
            buckets = np.where(
                labels.str.upper().eq("BENIGN"),
                "BENIGN",
                "ATTACK"
            )
            counts.update(
                pd.Series(buckets).value_counts().to_dict()
            )
            total_rows += len(chunk)
    return counts, total_rows, missing_labels

def load_external_binary_sample(paths, quotas, shared_features, chunk_size=EXTERNAL_CHUNK_SIZE, seed=RANDOM_STATE):
    """Second pass: keep a seeded reservoir sample for Benign/Attack, reading only shared columns."""
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    reservoirs = {"BENIGN": pd.DataFrame(), "ATTACK": pd.DataFrame()}

    for path in paths:
        info = external_file_info[path.name]
        feature_map = info["feature_map"]
        label_col = info["label_column"]
        required_raw_cols = list(dict.fromkeys([feature_map[f] for f in shared_features] + [label_col]))

        for chunk in pd.read_csv(
            path,
            usecols=required_raw_cols,
            chunksize=chunk_size,
            encoding=info["encoding"],
            low_memory=False,
        ):
            labels = chunk[label_col].astype("string").str.strip()
            valid = labels.notna() & labels.ne("")
            if not valid.any():
                continue

            valid_labels = labels.loc[valid]
            buckets = pd.Series(
                np.where(valid_labels.str.upper().eq("BENIGN"), "BENIGN", "ATTACK"),
                index=valid_labels.index,
            )
            feature_chunk = chunk.loc[valid, [feature_map[f] for f in shared_features]].copy()
            feature_chunk.columns = shared_features
            for feature in shared_features:
                numeric = pd.to_numeric(feature_chunk[feature], errors="coerce")
                feature_chunk[feature] = numeric.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).astype("float32")

            feature_chunk["target"] = buckets.map({"BENIGN": 0, "ATTACK": 1}).astype("int8")
            feature_chunk["external_label"] = valid_labels.astype(str).to_numpy()
            feature_chunk["_bucket"] = buckets.to_numpy()
            feature_chunk["_sampling_key"] = rng.random(len(feature_chunk))

            for bucket, quota in quotas.items():
                if quota <= 0:
                    continue
                current = feature_chunk.loc[feature_chunk["_bucket"] == bucket]
                if not current.empty:
                    reservoirs[bucket] = pd.concat(
                        [reservoirs[bucket], current], ignore_index=True
                    ).nsmallest(int(quota), "_sampling_key")

    sampled_parts = [r for r in reservoirs.values() if not r.empty]
    if not sampled_parts:
        raise RuntimeError("No external records were sampled; inspect CSV labels and schemas.")
    sampled = pd.concat(sampled_parts, ignore_index=True)
    sampled = sampled.drop(columns=["_bucket", "_sampling_key"])
    return sampled.sample(frac=1, random_state=seed).reset_index(drop=True)


external_generalization_results_df = pd.DataFrame()
external_feature_mapping_df = pd.DataFrame()
external_sample = None
cross_dataset_pipeline = None
CROSS_DATASET_ARTIFACT_PATH = None

if not EXTERNAL_DATASET_DIR.exists():
    print("External dataset not found. This section is ready but skipped.")
    print("Place the processed CSE-CIC-IDS2018 CSV files in:", EXTERNAL_DATASET_DIR)
else:
    external_csv_files = sorted(EXTERNAL_DATASET_DIR.rglob("*.csv"))
    if not external_csv_files:
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No external CSV files found under {EXTERNAL_DATASET_DIR}")

    MODEL_INPUT_COLUMNS = list(X_train.columns)
    external_file_info = {}
    mappings_by_file = {}
    missing_by_file = {}

    # Schema-only pass: no target values or feature values are used to train the model.
    for path in external_csv_files:
        raw_columns, encoding = read_external_csv_header(path)
        label_matches = [c for c in raw_columns if normalize_schema_token(c) == "label"]
        if len(label_matches) != 1:
            raise ValueError(f"Expected one external Label column in {path.name}; found {label_matches}")
        feature_map, missing, ambiguous = map_external_features(raw_columns, MODEL_INPUT_COLUMNS)
        if ambiguous:
            raise ValueError(f"Ambiguous external feature-name matches in {path.name}: {ambiguous}")
        duplicate_sources = pd.Series(list(feature_map.values())).value_counts()
        duplicate_sources = duplicate_sources[duplicate_sources > 1]
        if not duplicate_sources.empty:
            raise ValueError(
                f"One external column maps to multiple CIC-IDS2017 features in {path.name}: "
                f"{duplicate_sources.to_dict()}"
            )
        external_file_info[path.name] = {
            "encoding": encoding,
            "label_column": label_matches[0],
            "feature_map": feature_map,
        }
        mappings_by_file[path.name] = feature_map
        missing_by_file[path.name] = missing

    shared_features = [
        feature for feature in MODEL_INPUT_COLUMNS
        if all(feature in mappings_by_file[p.name] for p in external_csv_files)
    ]
    missing_anywhere = [f for f in MODEL_INPUT_COLUMNS if f not in shared_features]
    overlap_fraction = len(shared_features) / max(1, len(MODEL_INPUT_COLUMNS))

    external_feature_mapping_df = pd.DataFrame([
        {
            "cicids2017_model_feature": feature,
            "cic2018_external_column": mappings_by_file[external_csv_files[0].name].get(feature),
            "available_in_every_external_file": feature in shared_features,
        }
        for feature in MODEL_INPUT_COLUMNS
    ])
    show_table(external_feature_mapping_df, "CIC-IDS2017 ↔ CSE-CIC-IDS2018 feature mapping", max_rows=100)
    save_table(external_feature_mapping_df, "cic2017_cic2018_feature_mapping.csv")

    print(f"Shared model features: {len(shared_features):,}/{len(MODEL_INPUT_COLUMNS):,} ({overlap_fraction:.1%})")
    if missing_anywhere:
        print("Features not present in every external CSV:", missing_anywhere)
    if overlap_fraction < MIN_EXTERNAL_FEATURE_OVERLAP:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Only {overlap_fraction:.1%} of source features are shared. "
            "Do not invent missing values for absent semantic features. Review the feature mapping first."
        )
    if CATEGORICAL_FEATURES:
        raise NotImplementedError(
            "This transfer block currently expects the source CIC-IDS2017 model features to be numeric. "
            "Extend the shared preprocessor if categorical source predictors are introduced."
        )

    # Train a separate source-only transfer model on the shared feature intersection.
    # This avoids feeding fabricated/missing columns to the saved all-feature model.
    source_template = hyperparameter_searches[BEST_MODEL_NAME].best_estimator_
    source_preprocessor = source_template.named_steps["preprocessor"]
    numeric_template = clone(source_preprocessor.named_transformers_["numeric"])
    shared_preprocessor = ColumnTransformer(
        [("numeric", numeric_template, shared_features)],
        remainder="drop",
        sparse_threshold=0.0,
        verbose_feature_names_out=False,
    )
    sampler_template = source_template.named_steps["sampler"]
    selector_template = source_template.named_steps["selector"]
    cross_dataset_pipeline = ImbPipeline([
        ("preprocessor", shared_preprocessor),
        ("sampler", clone(sampler_template) if sampler_template != "passthrough" else "passthrough"),
        ("selector", clone(selector_template) if selector_template != "passthrough" else "passthrough"),
        ("model", clone(source_template.named_steps["model"])),
    ])

    print(f"\nTraining {BEST_MODEL_NAME} on CIC-IDS2017 using {len(shared_features)} shared features...")
    cross_dataset_pipeline.fit(X_train_validation[shared_features], y_train_validation)

    # First pass over the external set: obtain its natural binary prevalence.
    external_binary_counts, external_total_rows, external_missing_label_rows = scan_external_label_counts(
        external_csv_files
    )
    if not external_binary_counts:
        raise ValueError("No non-empty external labels were found.")
    available_external_rows = sum(external_binary_counts.values())
    if EXTERNAL_MAX_ROWS is None:
        external_sample_size = available_external_rows
    else:
        if EXTERNAL_MAX_ROWS <= 0:
            raise ValueError("EXTERNAL_MAX_ROWS must be positive or None.")
        external_sample_size = min(
            EXTERNAL_MAX_ROWS,
            available_external_rows
        )
    external_quotas = allocate_label_quotas(
        pd.Series(dict(external_binary_counts)), external_sample_size
    )
    print("External full-dataset rows scanned:", f"{external_total_rows:,}")
    print("External missing-label rows:", f"{external_missing_label_rows:,}")
    print("External binary counts:", dict(external_binary_counts))
    print("External sample quotas:", external_quotas)

    # Second pass: read only label + shared features and keep a natural-prevalence sample.
    external_sample = load_external_binary_sample(
        external_csv_files, external_quotas, shared_features
    )
    X_external = external_sample[shared_features]
    y_external = external_sample["target"].astype("int8")
    external_original_label_summary = (
        external_sample["external_label"].value_counts()
        .rename_axis("external_original_label").reset_index(name="sample_count")
    )
    show_table(external_original_label_summary, "CSE-CIC-IDS2018 sampled original labels", max_rows=40)
    print("External sample shape:", external_sample.shape)
    print("External sample memory (MB):", round(external_sample.memory_usage(deep=True).sum() / 1024**2, 2))
    print("External binary distribution:", y_external.value_counts(normalize=True).sort_index().round(4).to_dict())
    print("Binary mapping: Benign → 0 | every other non-empty external label → 1")

    # Evaluate on source holdout and external data using the SAME shared-feature model.
    source_common_pred = cross_dataset_pipeline.predict(X_test[shared_features])
    source_common_prob = cross_dataset_pipeline.predict_proba(X_test[shared_features])[:, 1]
    external_pred = cross_dataset_pipeline.predict(X_external)
    external_prob = cross_dataset_pipeline.predict_proba(X_external)[:, 1]

    source_common_metrics = calculate_metrics(y_test, source_common_pred, source_common_prob)
    external_metrics = calculate_metrics(y_external, external_pred, external_prob)
    external_generalization_results_df = pd.DataFrame([
        {"evaluation_dataset": "CIC-IDS2017 internal test (shared features)", "rows": len(y_test), **source_common_metrics},
        {"evaluation_dataset": "CSE-CIC-IDS2018 external sample", "rows": len(y_external), **external_metrics},
    ])
    show_table(
        external_generalization_results_df,
        "Cross-dataset generalization — same source-trained model, no external retraining",
        columns=["evaluation_dataset", "rows", "accuracy", "precision_attack", "recall_attack", "f1_attack", "f1_macro", "balanced_accuracy", "roc_auc", "average_precision", "mcc", "false_positive_rate", "false_negative_rate", "TN", "FP", "FN", "TP"],
    )
    save_table(external_generalization_results_df, "cross_dataset_generalization_metrics.csv")

    external_class_report = classification_report(
        y_external, external_pred, labels=[0, 1],
        target_names=["Benign", "Attack"], output_dict=True, zero_division=0
    )
    external_class_report_df = pd.DataFrame(external_class_report).T.reset_index(names="class_or_average")
    show_table(external_class_report_df, "CSE-CIC-IDS2018 external per-class report")
    save_table(external_class_report_df, "cic2018_external_per_class_metrics.csv")

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(18, 5))
    ConfusionMatrixDisplay.from_predictions(
        y_external, external_pred, labels=[0, 1],
        display_labels=["Benign", "Attack"], values_format="d",
        cmap="Blues", ax=axes[0], colorbar=False
    )
    axes[0].set_title("CSE-CIC-IDS2018 confusion matrix")
    RocCurveDisplay.from_predictions(y_external, external_prob, name="External", ax=axes[1])
    axes[1].set_title("External ROC curve")
    PrecisionRecallDisplay.from_predictions(y_external, external_prob, name="External", ax=axes[2])
    axes[2].set_title("External Precision–Recall curve")
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(FIGURES_DIR / "cic2018_external_evaluation.png", dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.show()

    # Persist the shared-feature transfer model and the exact external-column map.
    cross_dataset_artifact = {
        "artifact_name": "CIC-IDS2017-trained cross-dataset model for CSE-CIC-IDS2018",
        "model_name": BEST_MODEL_NAME,
        "pipeline": cross_dataset_pipeline,
        "input_feature_columns": shared_features,
        "target_mapping": {"BENIGN": 0, "ALL_OTHER_NONEMPTY_LABELS": 1},
        "source_dataset": "CIC-IDS2017",
        "external_evaluation_dataset": "CSE-CIC-IDS2018",
        "source_training_rows": int(len(X_train_validation)),
        "external_sample_rows": int(len(external_sample)),
        "external_feature_mapping_by_file": mappings_by_file,
        "selected_hyperparameters": hyperparameter_searches[BEST_MODEL_NAME].best_params_,
        "random_state": RANDOM_STATE,
    }
    CROSS_DATASET_ARTIFACT_PATH = MODEL_ARTIFACT_DIR / "cicids2017_shared_features_for_cicids2018.joblib"
    joblib.dump(cross_dataset_artifact, CROSS_DATASET_ARTIFACT_PATH, compress=3)
    print("Saved cross-dataset model:", CROSS_DATASET_ARTIFACT_PATH)

    # Keep predictions and labels for later threshold/error analysis if needed.
    external_predictions_df = pd.DataFrame({
        "external_label": external_sample["external_label"].to_numpy(),
        "y_true": y_external.to_numpy(),
        "y_pred": external_pred,
        "attack_probability": external_prob,
    })
    save_table(external_predictions_df, "cic2018_external_predictions_sample.csv")

30. Research interpretation and reproducibility checklist¶

Dataset and quality¶

  • Dataset version and all eight CSV inputs are identified.
  • Per-file row counts and original attack-family counts are reported.
  • Missing, infinite, duplicate, conflicting-vector, and outlier audits are reported.
  • Cross-partition exact-vector overlap is reported.
  • Any modeling sample is disclosed, including its sampling procedure.

Experimental validity¶

  • Split protocol matches the stated generalization question.
  • All learned preprocessing is fitted inside CV training folds.
  • Variance filtering / feature selection is fitted inside CV training folds.
  • Resampling is applied only inside CV training folds.
  • Pipeline and hyperparameter searches do not use the test set.
  • Validation is used for finalist comparison.
  • The final test partition is evaluated only after all choices are frozen.

Results and limitations¶

  • Report CV means and standard deviations, preferably per-fold results too.
  • Report Attack Precision/Recall/F1, Macro-F1, PR-AUC, ROC-AUC, FPR/FNR and MCC.
  • Explain false positives and false negatives.
  • Explain whether individually good preprocessing choices interact when combined.
  • Compare full-feature and SHAP-reduced models.
  • Report training time and prediction latency where feasible.
  • Acknowledge CIC-IDS2017's documented quality limitations.
  • Do not claim zero-day detection, cross-network generalization, or real-time deployment.
  • Acknowledge that repeated validation-based search can overfit the validation set; the untouched test set is the final check.

Model artifacts and external evaluation¶

  • Save the validation-selected full-feature pipeline with preprocessing and input schema.
  • Save the SHAP-reduced inference bundle when available.
  • Preserve the exact model input-column order and binary target mapping.
  • For CSE-CIC-IDS2018, report feature harmonization and use only shared, semantically matched features.
  • Train the transfer model on CIC-IDS2017 only; do not refit or tune on external records.
  • Report source-domain and external-domain scores for the same shared-feature model.
  • State that binary labels match after mapping; original attack-family taxonomies do not match one-to-one.

Supplied framework¶

Its generic pipeline options are not all valid search candidates for a low-cardinality Protocol feature or for this offline CIC-IDS2017 experiment.
